notes.title: 1.0.10 - Evolution Bug Fix
notes.notes:
I've just published a small update which fixes a bug in the evolution system.
Now, it should be possible to unlock all evolutions by treating your Kukumushi pets differently!

Please let me know if you have any problems.

notes.title: 1.0.7 - Game Speed Control
notes.notes:
I've added a feature which will give us more flexibility in how we raise our Kukumushi!
In the settings menu, you'll now find a handy time-control slider.
You can play at regular speed or 0.5x, 1.5x or even 2x speed.
This will affect the rate at which your pets evolve and have their stats change over time.
It doesn't speed up or slow down their walking, eating or sleeping animations.
I hope it's a useful feature!

I've also had some feedback about the 'energy' statistic depleting very quickly in some cases.
I have made changes so that it won't deplete quite as fast.

notes.title: 1.0.5 - Visuals and Sound Effects
notes.notes:
A very minor update, with just a few small changes.

The Flappy Plane minigame now has a variety of colours for your biplane. The plane's angle also changes to more accurately reflect its ascent or descent. There is also now a small particle burst which happens when the plane hits an obstacle.

There is now a short 'drop' sound effect after you select a new egg in the main game scene.

notes.title: 1.0.4 - Bugfixes and Minigame
notes.notes:
I'm publishing a larger update with various fixes and changes:

There are new sprites for the [i]Enemy Dodge[/i] minigame and an updated scoreboard for the [i]Pong[/i] minigame.
There are also new sprites for the cake and apple food options; now they look even more delicious!

I've fixed a small bug which resulted in a failure to change the pet's name after evolution. 
This only happened sometimes, so it took me a while to notice it!
I also found and fixed another bug with the background music. The music tracks now 'shuffle' as they should.

Finally, we have a new minigame. 
It's similar to [i]Flappy Bird[/i], but in this case your Kukumushi must fly through a cave full of perilous spikes. 
Let's get a high score!

notes.title: 1.0.3 - Mushidex
notes.notes:
I've finished implementing a new feature which will help you in your quest to unlock all [i]Kukumushi[/i] evolutions.
I proudly present, the [i]Mushidex[/i]! 
It's a menu that can be accessed directly from the HUD while in-game, showing all the evolutions unlocked so far. 
In addition, there are diagrams to indicate the evolution paths required to unlock any pets you have yet to discover.
Also, it's totally original, and isn't anything like a [i]Pokédex[/i]. Why would you even say that?

Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.0.2 - Steam Achievements
notes.notes:
Good news, everyone! 
[i]Kukumushi Virtual Pet[/i] now includes Steam achievements; one for every evolution.
